text:
maya: Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands — quick follow-up: notes, links, and action items below. Please add owners or correct anything I missed.

maya: Recording + slides: https://drive.company/ah/1795 (meant to share live, uploaded now)

kevin: Quick clarification on Redwood Private timeline — are we still targeting a pilot window in May and GA in Q3?

ryan: Yes — pilot customers onboarding in mid-May, GA target is late Q3 but calendar depends on compliance signoffs (SOC2 + regional data controls).

tara: For docs: we'll have a "Private quickstart" + network checklist. Maya — can we get a short PR to the docs repo this week?

maya: Yep. Docs PR planned for Friday. Link to draft: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1245

sam: Action items I captured (please edit):
- Pilot onboarding runbook (owner: tara) — due 2026-05-10
- KMS/HSM integration guide (owner: kevin) — due 2026-05-20
- Sales one-pager for Private offering (owner: lina) — due 2026-05-05
- Console UX tweaks for tenant isolation (owner: eng-ux) — due 2026-06-01

lina: For the sales one-pager — can product confirm pricing model? Will Dedicated customers see any pricing delta vs Private?

maya: No change planned to Dedicated pricing for committed customers. Private will be licensed (platform + support) — final pricing details next week after legal review.

kevin: Re: KMS — do we have preferred KMS vendors for pilot? AWS KMS + GCP CMEK supported, and there's a stub for Vault. Will send template config.

kevin: config snippet for pilot (in-thread):
```
kms_provider: aws
key_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
mode: decrypt-only
```

ops-bot: Recording uploaded to #all-hands-docs and autogenerated transcript available: https://drive.company/ah/transcript-1795.txt

tara: I'll drop the onboarding runbook outline in Confluence today — ping me if you want reviewer access.

maya: One more clarification from roadmap Q&A: "Optimize" features (batching advisor + quantization suggestions) are still on the H2 roadmap; no ETA change for H1.

lina: Noted — sales team will avoid promising Optimize timelines to customers until H2 shipping signals.

sam: Small FYI: ops will run a dry-run of pilot infra on 2026-05-03 — will need one SME from infra + one from security.

kevin: I'll take infra SME slot. @tara can you confirm security?

tara: Security will nominate @alex-security by EOD.

maya: Final ask — please react with :white_check_mark: once your action item is acknowledged, or reply with updates here. I'll compile a tidy checklist and send a calendar invite for the first pilot sync.

kevin: :white_check_mark:

tara: :white_check_mark:

lina: Added owner — :white_check_mark:

ryan: Thanks all. Great questions and good momentum.

maya: Closing thread for today, will post the compiled checklist and invite by tomorrow morning.
